name: contactSPACE
description_en:
contactSPACE provides outbound contact strategy and campaign tools that can sit on top of Twilio, Amazon Connect, Zoom Contact Center or another communications platform. It also offers an AWS-hosted full-stack contact centre for inbound/outbound blending. These are alternative implementation paths, not proof that every deployment includes the same carrier, agent interface or parent-platform entitlements.

For an illustrative follow-up campaign, select records by eligibility and priority, choose a dialing mode and contact window, guide the agent through a CallGuide or custom interface, then log the outcome back to the chosen record system. CallGuides are explicitly an optional add-on. Public sources establish that commercial boundary and requested demos, but not fees, billing units or trial terms. No account, call, integration, payment or export was tested.
description_zh:
contactSPACE 提供外呼联系策略及活动工具，可叠加在Twilio、Amazon Connect、Zoom Contact Center或其他通信平台上，也提供AWS托管、混合呼入／外呼的完整联络中心。这些是不同实施路径，不证明每种部署都含相同运营商、客服界面或母平台权益。

以假设跟进活动为例，按资格及优先级选择记录，选拨号模式及联系时间，用CallGuide或自定义界面引导客服，再将结果记回所选记录系统。CallGuides明确为可选附加项。公开来源确认此商业边界及需申请演示，未建立费用、计费单位或试用条款。未测试账户、电话、集成、付款或导出。

en: An enterprise extending an existing programmable contact-centre platform with outbound strategy and agent workflows.

选择完整托管平台、同时掌握活动及联系人资料责任的混合运营团队。

sections.title_en: Outbound orchestration can extend a stack or become the stack
sections.title_zh: 外呼编排可扩展原平台，也可构成完整平台
sections.en:
contactSPACE presents plugins/APIs alongside a full-stack contact-centre option. The current menu names contactSPACE Red for Twilio,4connect for Amazon Connect,4zoom for Zoom Contact Center and4outbound for other solutions. The broad integration message is an implementation choice,not proof of identical features or a single inclusive subscription across all platforms.

Its full-stack page describes AWS-hosted inbound/outbound blending,skills routing,queues,IVR and digital contact tools. Existing CPaaS users can instead keep their communications foundation and add outbound strategy. Decide which layer owns numbers,voice delivery,contact records,agent UI and reporting before comparing costs. Claims of instant deployment or infinite scale are vendor statements;no capacity or failover test was performed.
sections.zh:
contactSPACE同时提供插件／API和完整联络中心平台。当前菜单列Twilio用contactSPACE Red、Amazon Connect用4connect、Zoom Contact Center用4zoom及其他方案用4outbound。宽泛集成信息代表实施选择，不证明所有平台功能相同或一份订阅全含。

完整平台页描述AWS托管混合呼入／外呼、技能路由、队列、IVR及数字联系工具。已有CPaaS的用户也可保留通信底层并加外呼策略。比成本前应确定哪层负责号码、语音投递、联系人记录、客服界面及报告。即时部署或无限扩展是厂商说法，未做容量或故障切换测试。

sections.title_en: Match the dialer to the permitted contact strategy
sections.title_zh: 将拨号器匹配获准联系策略
sections.en:
For an illustrative follow-up segment,begin with accurate contact details,eligibility,preferred channels and allowed contact times. Preview lets an agent review and choose when to call;Progressive places the call after a configured delay;Predictive dials in the background and connects answered calls. Super Dialer is described as combining progressive/predictive approaches. These modes have different implications for staffing and personalization.

The product page lists internal/external DNC checks,time-zone rules,abandonment controls,contact-status-based strategy and required messaging. Those tools can support an approved design,but do not decide whether the business has a valid basis to contact a person. An unknown or stale compliance status needs a defined hold/manual path rather than an assumed predictive attempt. Test no-answer,wrong-number and opt-out outcomes against the actual record system.
sections.zh:
以假设跟进分组为例，先保证联系人资料、资格、偏好渠道及允许时间准确。Preview让客服查看后决定何时拨打，Progressive在配置延迟后拨打，Predictive在后台拨号并连接已接电话，Super Dialer称结合渐进／预测。各模式对人员容量及个性化有不同要求。

产品页列内部／外部DNC检查、时区规则、放弃控制、按联系人状态选择策略及必需消息。这些工具能支持获批设计，但不决定企业是否有有效联系依据。未知或过期合规状态应有暂停／人工路径，不能默认进入预测拨号。应对真实记录系统测试未接、错号及退出联系结果。

sections.title_en: CallGuides are an optional workflow,not a universal interface
sections.title_zh: CallGuides是可选流程，不是通用必备界面
sections.en:
CallGuides provide campaign-specific visual agent workflows and scripting. Team leaders use a visual editor,agents step through information and multimedia,then capture outcomes and wrap the call. The official page explicitly calls this an optional add-on and permits custom user interfaces. Do not infer that every Twilio,Connect or full-stack project will show the same screen or include the same paid module.

For a campaign script,decide which fields are merely displayed and which must be saved as outcomes. Reaching the final guide page does not prove that the CRM accepted an update. The integrations page describes APIs and CRM push/pull paths,but does not provide a reviewed authentication,retry or transactional contract here. Test a failed write and a repeated submission before depending on the final screen as proof of a completed business action.
sections.zh:
CallGuides提供活动专属可视化客服流程及脚本，团队负责人用可视编辑器，客服逐步查看信息／多媒体，再采集结果及收尾。官方页明确称它为可选附加项，并允许自定义界面。不能认为每个Twilio、Connect或完整平台项目都有同屏或同一付费模块。

活动脚本应明确哪些字段只展示，哪些必须保存为结果。到最后一页不证明CRM接受更新。集成页描述API及CRM推拉路径，但此次没有已审查认证、重试或事务合同。依赖最终界面证明业务完成前，应测试写入失败及重复提交。

sections.title_en: An integration catalogue is not a tested payment or data contract
sections.title_zh: 集成目录不是已测支付或资料合同
sections.en:
The official integration page describes Twilio Voice/Flex paths,Amazon Connect plugins and CRM options such as Salesforce,HubSpot,ServiceNow and Zendesk. These establish named connection paths,not version parity,permission isolation or guaranteed delivery. Map the chosen record identifiers and decide which platform owns a contact update and its audit trail.

Payment gateways are listed through pcipayspace,including Stripe,Braintree and others. A listed gateway does not establish merchant approval,base-plan inclusion,refund authority or an independently verified PCI scope for the chosen deployment. This research did not submit payment data or test a financial workflow. Broader AI virtual-agent functionality appears in the platform menu but detailed model,tool permissions,data residency and usage limits remain unverified.
sections.zh:
官方集成页描述Twilio Voice／Flex、Amazon Connect插件及Salesforce、HubSpot、ServiceNow、Zendesk等CRM选项。这些确认有命名连接路径，不确认版本同等、权限隔离或保证投递。需映射所选记录标识，明确哪个平台负责联系人更新及审计。

pcipayspace列Stripe、Braintree等支付网关，有网关不证明商户批准、基础套餐已含、退款权限或所选部署的独立PCI范围。此次未提交支付资料或测试金融流程。平台菜单还列AI虚拟客服，但详细模型、工具权限、资料驻留及用量限制未核。

sections.title_en: Optional commercial scope is public;fees remain unknown
sections.title_zh: 公开可选商业范围，费用仍未知
sections.en:
The commercial fact actually established is that CallGuides is optional;the public contact page offers a requested demo. The reviewed pages do not publish amounts,seat/concurrency units,minimums,commitments,free-trial conditions or bundled carrier/CPaaS charges. This profile records the add-on condition without inventing a starting price or treating a demo as an ongoing free plan. Request a deployment-specific quote covering platform,telecom,interfaces,professional services,AI and export requirements;these are evaluation categories,not verified separate fees.

No actual SaaS license,cancellation/refund agreement or complete data-export contract was reviewed,so license and those rights remain unknown. contactSPACE fits teams prepared to design outbound strategy around an existing communications stack or a configured full-stack operation. Buyers expecting a self-service public price,unrestricted autonomous calls or verified universal integrations need more evidence. Complete recording export,restore,retention,data regions,UI languages and independently checked reliability remain open.
sections.zh:
实际建立的商业事实是CallGuides可选，公开联系页提供需申请演示。已读页面没有金额、座席／并发单位、最低数、承诺、免费试用条件或所含运营商／CPaaS费。本档案记录附加项条件，不虚构起价，也不把演示当长期免费方案。需按部署索取涵盖平台、电话、界面、专业服务、AI及导出的报价；这些是评估类别，不是已证单独费用。

未审阅真实SaaS许可、取消／退款协议或完整资料导出合同，因此许可及这些权利保持未知。contactSPACE适合愿围绕已有通信栈或已配置完整平台设计外呼策略的团队。期待自助公开价格、无限自主电话或已验通用集成的买家仍需证据。完整录音导出、恢复、留存、资料地区、界面语言及独立可靠性仍开放。
